source.cad: Rye Field Model RM-5010 Tiger I 1/35 full-interior kit CAD (SolidWorks AP214 STEP + SLDPRT metadata)
source.labels: kit part numbers and names from the SolidWorks files' custom properties (Tiger-I(SW).zip), linked to STEP solids by cached mass (ABS 1.02 g/cm^3) plus position

frames.hull: engine hull metres: origin at ground contact, +Y up, +Z forward (barrel), +X vehicle left
frames.turret: turret-local metres = hull minus the game turret pivot, turret yaw 0

scale_note: The game's Tiger is this kit CAD at 0.0389198 m per kit mm, 1.1120 x the kit's nominal 1:35 (0.035 m/mm): every box below is in that game scale, about 11 % larger than the real vehicle the kit represents.

envelope_error_fields.max_vertex_outside_box_mm: largest distance of any tessellated vertex outside the box (box fitted to the vertices, so ~0)
envelope_error_fields.max_brep_outside_box_mm: largest excursion of the exact B-rep surface past any box face (OCC optimal bounds without triangulation, per box axis); a point's distance from the box is at most sqrt(3) times this
envelope_error_fields.chord_tolerance_mm: tessellation chord tolerance used for the vertices, engine millimetres
envelope_error_fields.empty_fraction: 1 - fused solid volume / box volume: how much of the box is not kit material

game_mesh_field: status present / partial / absent: whether the game's own GLBs draw this component's kit solids (vertex proximity, exact point-to-triangle check where ambiguous)

components.name: Engine block (kit 'MAIN 引擎主體', engine main body)
components.evidence: SolidWorks part TG_RM5010-28U05 'MAIN(引擎主體)' (engine main body) in assembly 0B29 EngineSystem, merging kit pieces U6/U7/U16/U21/U22/U29/U32/H35/H55/H61/H63/H64; its cached mass 10.61 g equals this solid's volume x ABS 1.02 g/cm^3 (10.614 g); identical invariants to the largest solid of the separate EngineSystem STEP; rear compartment centreline between the two side compartments.
components.doubts: One merged kit body: the engine-mounted kit pieces listed are fused into it, so sub-parts cannot be separated. Its B-rep carries five small internal void shells (kit_cavities).

kit_cavities.note: internal void shells in the kit B-rep (volume in kit mm^3)

components.name: Engine air filters, pair (kit 28U20 'FILTER TANK')
components.evidence: File label 'FILTER TANK' (28U20, EngineSystem; 0.65 g = 0.652 g); the only EngineSystem part instanced twice (14 STEP solids from 13 part files); two identical axisymmetric drums on top of the engine block.
components.doubts: The SolidWorks part carries no Chinese description, only the file label.

components.name: Radiator, left side compartment (kit 27K76 'COOLBOX 冷卻箱')
components.evidence: Part 27K76 'COOLBOX(冷卻箱)' (cooling box) in 0B23 EngineRoom, 2.85 g = 2.849 g (unique); flat block 9.3 kit mm deep across the airflow, between the fuel-tank shells (front) and the twin-fan shroud (rear) of the left rear side compartment, filler neck on top.
components.doubts: The kit models the core and header as one body; no tubes or coolant are modelled.

components.name: Radiator, right side compartment (kit 27K77 'COOLBOX 冷卻箱')
components.evidence: Mirror of radiator_left: part 27K77 'COOLBOX(冷卻箱)', 2.84 g = 2.837 g (unique).
components.doubts: As radiator_left.

components.name: Cooling fan pair and shroud, left (kit 27H13 'COVER 風扇罩' + rotors)
components.evidence: Part 27H13 'COVER(風扇罩)' (fan cover/shroud, 0B23 EngineRoom, 0.60 g = 0.601 g, one per side) with two circular ducts; the companion solid is the pair of eight-bladed fan rotors with hubs seated in those ducts (geometry), 0.21 g, consistent with the unlabelled EngineRoom part 27H25 (the other 0.21 g candidates are turret parts). The game's fan derivative (catalog/tiger_workshop_cooling.v1.json) was cut from this rotor solid's mesh.
components.doubts: The rotor solid's part number is inferred from mass and folder (27H25_PLATE carries no description).

components.name: Gearbox casing (kit 21K49 'BOX 轉向機')
components.evidence: Part 21K49 'BOX(轉向機)' (steering gear) in 0B21 DriverRoom, 5.00 g = 5.000 g (unique): the longitudinal casing on the centreline between the driver's and radio operator's stations, directly behind the transverse steering unit and in line with the propeller shaft.
components.doubts: The kit names all three transmission housings 轉向機 (steering gear: main / middle / rear); naming this one the gearbox rests on its longitudinal shape and position (gearbox behind the transversely mounted steering unit), not on the kit label.

components.name: Steering unit with end covers (kit 21K54 / 21K51 / 21K59)
components.evidence: Parts 21K54 'BOX(轉向機中)' (steering gear, middle; 1.43 g) and 21K51 'BOX(轉向機後)' (steering gear, rear; 2.57 g) form the transverse housing at the hull front, with 21K59 'COVER(外罩)' (outer cover, 0.86 g, two instances) drum covers on both ends facing the final drives; all four in 0B21 DriverRoom and in the Base Unit STEP.
components.doubts: The transverse housing's internal split (steering gear vs brakes) is not modelled.

components.name: Radio sets (probable; kit 21K57 'BOX 控制盒', control box)
components.evidence: Part 21K57 'BOX(控制盒)' (control box, 0B21 DriverRoom, 1.18 g = 1.179 g; the other 1.18 g part 27H12 is in the engine room): two stacked boxes on top of the gearbox between the driver and the radio operator, with a face of knobs, plugs and panels turned towards the radio operator's side (-X), where the Tiger I carried its radio sets.
components.doubts: The kit label says 'control box', not radio: the radio identification is inferred from position and face detail.

components.name: Final drive housing, left (kit 29D56 'DRIVER' + 18-22/23 'COVER 前輪殼')
components.evidence: Part 29D56 'DRIVER' (0.58 g = 0.584 g, two instances) is coaxial with the drive sprocket (sprocket axis at kit y 8.2, z 6.0 mm) between the hull side and the sprocket; the mirror pair 18-22/18-23 'COVER(前輪殼)' (front-wheel housing, 0.61 g) is the casing plate behind it on the hull side.
components.doubts: Only the external housing is modelled; the reduction gears inside are not.

components.name: Sponson ammunition bin, left rear (16 rounds)
components.evidence: 23M03 'AMMO(砲彈)' (shell: complete 8.8 cm round, 0.13 g = 0.125 g, 25.2 x 3.0 kit mm, 70 identical solids, 4 x 4 in this bin), 25M06 'BLACKET(砲彈架)' (shell rack) shelves and 24H03 'COVER(砲彈儲槽蓋)' (shell storage bin cover) closing the bin towards the fighting compartment.
components.doubts: The kit carries 70 rounds in total; the vehicle's full stowage is not modelled.

game_mesh.note: tiger_hull.glb omits these 16 rounds (tiger_rack_source.json: cartridges excluded from the static hull); the game draws rounds at tiger_interior.json shell slots on these rounds' axes (64 of 65 slots: lateral offset <= 5.5 mm, slot point 74 mm along the axis from the solid centroid). The bin cover is in no game mesh; the shelves are.

components.name: Hull machine gun (kit 28B-K81 + 28B-K07 'GUN 機槍')
components.evidence: Two collinear rods on one axis (kit x -16.4, y 30.5-31.0, along z) behind the front plate on the right (radio operator's) side; masses 0.05 g and 0.03 g match the front-armour unit's 28B-K81 and 28B-K07 'GUN(機槍)' (machine gun); the game node 'MG Operater' sits beside it.
components.doubts: Many small parts share these masses; the labels rest on mass plus position. The ball mount and trigger parts are not included.

components.name: Driver's seat (kit 20K67 'CHAIR 椅子' + 20K65 'CHAIR 椅座架')
components.evidence: A chair with backrest (0.17 g, 20K67 'CHAIR(椅子)') on a four-legged frame (0.06 g, 20K65 'CHAIR(椅座架)', seat frame), both 0B21 DriverRoom, at the left front driver's station.
components.doubts: Other parts share both masses; the labels rest on mass plus shape and position.

components.name: 88 mm gun breech ring and block (kit 02U03 'ROOM 供彈座')
components.evidence: Part 02U03 'ROOM(供彈座)' (loading seat, merged U3+U4, 0C02 Barrel Base Unit, 1.11 g = 1.113 g, unique) on the bore axis behind the trunnion; it is the solid the game's tiger_gun.glb names 'Breech' (matched by invariants).
components.doubts: Breech ring and block are one kit body (02U03 merges kit pieces U3+U4). The kit also lists a small 02J54 'BLOCK(炮門)' (breech block, 0.08 g) that was not located among the many 0.08 g solids.

components.doubts: 19K28_BASE (floor hatch) has the same mass; the CAD does not establish that real vehicles stowed cans here.
